headline: A little robot for the useful bits of your day.
description: DaBin keeps your ideas, links, images and files together on your Mac. Drop something onto the robot, keep it with a project, and find it again when you need it.

page_one.title: Hi, I'm DaBin.
page_one.intro: I keep the useful bits of your day - an idea, a link, an image or a file - so you can find them again and get back to work.
page_one.quick_start: Find me at your chosen screen corner or camera island. Drop something onto me, press Command-V while hovering, or click once to open.

callouts.title: Choose a project
callouts.body: Keep notes, tasks, links and files together. Use filters and the compact date picker to choose a day or week.

callouts.title: Three places to begin
callouts.body: Captions catches new things. Tasks helps you focus. Projects keeps related work together.

callouts.title: Search all saved work
callouts.body: Click Search to look across your saved DaBin content, even when you start inside a project.

callouts.title: Take work with you
callouts.body: Check the items you want, then use Export Selected to save a local ZIP. The nearby menu opens the project folder in Finder.

page_one.meet_body: Approach your chosen corner and I peek out, grip the edge and reach toward your pointer. Drop something onto me, hover and press Command-V, or click once to open.
page_one.island_note: Prefer the camera island? Choose it in Settings. On displays without an island, I use the top-right corner.

page_two.title: Save it. Find it. Pick it up again.
page_two.subtitle: Three small habits, plus a little help when you want it.

steps.title: Find it by a few words.
steps.body: In Search, type or paste a word. Matches line up in date columns, newest first. Use filters when you want to narrow things down.
steps.tip: Search covers your saved content. Files can contribute locally extracted text when available.

steps.title: Save now. Sort later.
steps.body: Drop or paste something into Captions. The idea/task input shows the project that will receive it. Open a card to add a comment or choose its project.
steps.tip: Drag a card preview, title or caption into an app that accepts that content. Your saved original stays here.

steps.title: Give one task your attention.
steps.body: Click + to open New task. Priority tags go from green (Low), through amber (Medium), to red (High).
steps.tip: Set a focus time and press Play. When time is up, the robot reminds you; mark the task done when you finish.

page_two.auto_title: A little help saving? Your choice.
page_two.auto_body: Auto Capture is off by default. In Settings, choose Clipboard, Screenshots, or both; screenshots need a folder you select. It saves new changes, not a recording of your screen.
page_two.auto_tip: The red dot shows recording. Rapid saves share a count. Quiet mode and Reduce Motion stay still. Pause anytime.
page_two.comfort_body: Drag an empty spot at the top to move between monitors. Resize from an edge or use Expand. Saved content stays on this Mac. Website previews are optional.
page_two.privacy_title: Your things stay on your Mac.
page_two.privacy_body: No account or cloud sync. Link previews only contact websites if you turn them on.
